Name: Tackle Box
Author: pheauxm
Description:
This mod adds Tackle Box furniture items that can store unlimited bait and tackle and be picked up and placed anywhere normal furniture can. They work like dressers and have their own tabs to sort by only bait or only tackle.

There are seven base colors, each with a rotation showing a different shade, for a total of 14 colors. They are available in Willy's shop once you reach fishing level 2 and unlock bait (each day he will have a random base color), PLUS you can use the sewing machine to dye a box to a different color (e.g., use a blue item with any color box to get a blue colored box).

And them being classified as furniture means NPCs won't destroy them for being in a walking path. :]


This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to add the tackle boxes as items and uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32123]Custom Catalogues and Dressers Framework[/url] to create the custom dresser menu.

The tab icons will be recolored to match if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface V2[/url] active since that mod's author has open permissions. Please contact the author of a recolor if you want compatibility added here. Permission is automatically granted to edit the tab icons for existing interface recolors, however, please don't upload a mod solely to recolor these tabs and nothing else.

1.1.0 adds recolors of the tackle boxes for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url] (and will also work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url] but were made with Vibrant Pastoral mainly in mind).
